LESSON: READING 6.4.1 ORAL LITERATURE: SONGS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.4: Reading 6.4.1 Oral literature: Songs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 6.4.1 Oral literature: Songs. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How are songs similar to poems?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify repeated words and phrases in lullabies
2. use appropriate techniques when performing lullabies, pick out key messages communicated in lullabies
3. appreciate the importance of lullabies in real life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 6.4.1 ORAL LITERATURE: SONGS
This lesson teaches Reading 6.4.1 Oral literature: Songs for Grade 7 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify repeated words and phrases in lullabies
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use appropriate techniques when performing lullabies, pick out key messages communicated in lullabies
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the importance of lullabies in real life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 6.4.1 Oral literature: Songs using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 6.4.1 Oral literature: Songs above.
2. Explain Reading 6.4.1 Oral literature: Songs to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 6.4.1 Oral literature: Songs.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 6.4.1 Oral literature: Songs with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 6.4.1 Oral literature: Songs important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are songs similar to poems?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify repeated words and phrases in lullabies
2. use appropriate techniques when performing lullabies, pick out key messages communicated in lullabies
3. appreciate the importance of lullabies in real life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
